symptom: `show references to <UserRole>` / `show impact of` reported nothing for the retrieves and access rules that name the role by its XPath token '[%UserRole_X%]', so a role in use read as unused.
cause: The reference graph had no USER_ROLE target at all; extractXPathRefs resolved only attributes, associations and enumeration values in each constraint.
fix: Each xpath_expressions row's tokens become `xpath` edges to USER_ROLE <name>, only for roles the project has (case-sensitive, as mxbuild matches); an access rule's edge comes from its entity, as for its other XPath edges.
insight: xpath_expressions already covers flows, page data sources and access rules, so the token edges needed no new walk — the place to add a target kind is the extractor that has already found the constraint. Live on 11.12.6: refs and impact on Spare list the access rule's entity and the retrieve's microflow, the two places mx reports CE1613 after the drop.
